subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification - FinEdge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hernandez <tom@finedge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity follow-up and next steps

Hi Tom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about FinEdge's roadmap. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can size Dedicated properly: 

Summary from call:
- Primary workload: real-time customer support responses + nightly batch indexing for search relevance.
- Estimated monthly usage: 1.0B to 1.5B tokens/month initially, with Q3 target growth to ~3B tokens/month.
- Latency target: p95 generation latency under 250ms for typical prompts.
- Throughput requirement: support 120 concurrent interactive sessions during peak (roughly 1.5k qps with batching).

Questions / confirmation for pricing model:
1) GPU preference: you mentioned preference for H100 for peak throughput. Is H100 required or is A100 80GB acceptable if it materially reduces cost?
2) Reserved capacity size: from the numbers above we estimate 4x H100 or 8x A100 equivalent to meet throughput and headroom. Does that match your internal expectations?
3) Budget range: you indicated a target cost of about $300 per 1M tokens as a unit target for budgeting. Can you confirm target budget range per 1M tokens (band is fine)?

Attached is a one-page demand sheet I drafted from our notes and a quick model showing estimated unit economics at 1B and 3B tokens/month. Neha (cc) will align on perf assumptions.

Next steps:
- If numbers look reasonable, schedule a sizing call with Marcus to go through pricing and contract terms this week.
- If you can share an anonymized sample of prompt lengths / typical token per request, we can refine the throughput estimate.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: FinEdge_Demand_Sheet.xlsx

From: Tom Hernandez <tom@finedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@finedge.com>, Rahul Iyer <rahul@finedge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up and next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side:
- Monthly tokens: initial baseline 1.2B tokens/month, runway to 2.8B by end of Q3.
- Latency: p95 under 250ms is important for our chat UX.
- Throughput: 120 interactive concurrent users at peak, but those are bursty — hope the autoscaling/burst options help.

On GPU preference: we prefer H100 if pricing delta vs A100 is within ~25%. If A100 halves the cost, we could consider it.

Budget: our finance team has penciled in a target of $250 to $350 per 1M tokens for planning. If you can hit sub-$300 at scale that would be ideal.

I can share a small sample of prompts by end of day tomorrow. Let's lock a time for technical sizing on Thursday — Marcus is fine to join.

Best,
Tom
CTO, FinEdge
Tom Hernandez <tom@finedge.com>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hernandez <tom@finedge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up and next steps

Tom — great, thanks for confirming. Quick response and initial pricing orientation based on your inputs: 

Sizing assumptions (provisional):
- Token mix: 70% generation, 30% embeddings/indexing.
- Avg tokens per interactive request: 220 tokens.
- Batch efficiency estimate: 1.6x effective throughput improvement with batching and prefix caching.

Throughput / capacity options:
- Option A (H100 reserved): 4 x H100 (reserved) => estimated sustained capacity to handle your peak with 20-30% headroom.
  - Estimated effective throughput: ~1800 tokens/sec sustained across pool (after batching)
  - Estimated monthly unit cost (incl. infra + support + license amort): ~$270 per 1M tokens at 1.2B tokens/month, improving to ~$220 per 1M at 3B tokens/month.
- Option B (A100 80GB reserved): 8 x A100 (reserved) => similar capacity but higher latency tail, slightly lower per-GPU throughput
  - Estimated unit cost: ~$210 per 1M tokens at 1.2B tokens/month, ~$180 per 1M at 3B tokens/month.

Notes:
- The per-1M numbers include reserved GPU amortization, orchestration, and our caching/batching savings but exclude any committed data egress charges.
- If H100 is required for model performance (e.g., very high context windows, large encoder/decoder models), we can optimize placement and batching to get closer to your target.

Attachments: updated demand sheet + simple cost model. I included two price bands to show sensitivity to GPU type and utilization.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical sizing call with Marcus and Neha to validate perf assumptions and batch efficiency (Thursday 14:00 PT works for us).
2) If sizing aligns, we can provide a firm Dedicated pricing quote and 30-day window for Reserved Capacity commitment.
3) We will prepare an SOW draft with two options (H100 and A100) for your procurement and finance review.

Would you like us to push a preliminary quote ahead of the call or wait until after the perf validation?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinEdge_Demand_Sheet.xlsx, SOW_draft_v3.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hernandez <tom@finedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity follow-up and next steps

Hi Tom,

Appreciate the context. Quick operational note ahead of the Thursday sizing call:
- If you confirm H100 preference, we will size conservatively at 4x H100 to meet latency and headroom targets.
- If you opt for A100 to hit a lower unit cost, we recommend 8x A100 with tuning to reduce p95.
- For procurement cadence: our Dedicated pricing quotes are valid for 30 days from issue. We typically see best unit economics at >= 2B tokens/month committed.

During the call we will validate: sample prompt set, target p95, and any privacy/KMS requirements that affect deployment mode.

See you Thursday.

Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
